answers.assumption_check: Two load-bearing assumptions, both checked: (a) REINDEX DATABASE rebuilds every index from the heap, so indexes sorted under glibc 2.39 are re-sorted under 2.43 and REFRESH then records the truth (postgres's documented fix, the HINT in the warning itself); (b) sudo -u postgres runs without a password on akienasus (passwordless since 2026-11-11), needed for postgres and template1, which the postgres role owns. cairn is owned by akien. REINDEX DATABASE takes locks on each table while it runs; the cairn db is 9.6 MB, so the window is seconds.
answers.builder_check: A Haiku builder would ask: which databases? (every one whose datcollversion IS NOT NULL and differs from the actual, listed by one query in the apply); as whom? (the database's owner: psql as the caller for its own, sudo -u postgres psql for the rest); in what order? (REINDEX before REFRESH, never REFRESH alone); and how is green read? (the verify's single query returns zero rows, and a psql connect to cairn prints no 'collation version mismatch'). The intention carries each.
answers.children: none, because the apply and verify are one intention file and one host; akiendelllinux is measured by the orchestrator on its own box
answers.collision_check: Over the whys: 3ef8654a8027 (remote db sync) is about which rows the db holds, this about its host-level collation record, so they are distinct and do not exclude each other. Outline 11.3.5 says Recovery installs and upgrades postgres; this intention is the recipe an upgrade needs, not a rival owner, and it records that Recovery has no step to run it yet (a distinction, not a collision).
answers.falsifier_check: Clause 1: the intention's verify exits 0 on akienasus after the apply. Clause 2: the verify exits non-zero while any database's datcollversion differs from pg_database_collation_actual_version (measured before the apply, 2026-11-13: cairn, postgres and template1 all 2.39 vs 2.43). Horizon: after every OS release upgrade that moves glibc.
answers.gates_bound: host-seam's proof gate: run the intention's verify on the host and record the VALIDATION (seal expires: re-verify on the horizon); REBUILD gate: the apply block alone takes a fresh box there; durability: proven and committed. Feeds back to origin on a red verify, split as recipe-wrong vs host-drifted.
answers.missing_check: template0 records no datcollversion, so it is skipped by the predicate rather than special-cased. REINDEX DATABASE cannot run inside a transaction block, so each statement is its own psql -c. Nothing else is asserted wrapped that is not.
